output.summary: Enjoys mind-bending sci-fi narratives with deep themes and strong directorial vision.

candidates.title: Branded
candidates.overview: In a dystopian future, where corporate brands have created a disillusioned population, one man's effort to unlock the truth behind the conspiracy leads to an epic battle with hidden forces that control the world.

candidates.title: Interstellar
candidates.path: Inception → Director: Christopher Nolan → Interstellar
candidates.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

candidates.title: Altered States
candidates.overview: A research scientist explores the boundaries and frontiers of consciousness. Using sensory deprivation and hallucinogenic mixtures from native American shamans, he explores these altered states of consciousness and finds that memory, time, and perhaps reality itself are states of mind.

candidates.title: The Dark Knight Rises
candidates.path: Inception → Director: Christopher Nolan → The Dark Knight Rises
candidates.overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.

candidates.title: Parallels
candidates.overview: An underground MMA fighter must confront his sister and his past in an adventure through parallel universes

candidates.title: Dunkirk
candidates.path: Inception → Director: Christopher Nolan → Dunkirk
candidates.overview: The story of the miraculous evacuation of Allied soldiers from Belgium, Britain, Canada and France, who were cut off and surrounded by the German army from the beaches and harbour of Dunkirk between May 26th and June 4th 1940 during World War II.

candidates.title: Scanners
candidates.overview: After a man with extraordinary—and frighteningly destructive—telepathic abilities is nabbed by agents from a mysterious rogue corporation, he discovers he is far from the only possessor of such strange powers, and that some of the other “scanners” have their minds set on world domination, while others are trying to stop them.

candidates.title: Alien
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → Alien
candidates.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.

candidates.title: Terminus
candidates.overview: Following a near-fatal accident, David Chamberlain makes an unprecedented discovery that will not only determine the fate of his family, but of mankind.

candidates.title: Fire Birds
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → Fire Birds
candidates.overview: A joint task force operation between the Drug Enforcement Administration and the U.S. Army has been formed to dismantle one of the largest drug cartels operating in South America. Multiple attempts to assault the cartel's mountainous compound have been thwarted by a Scorpion-attack helicopter piloted by a cartel leader, Eric Stoller (Bert Rhine). After having several aircraft shot down, most notably a pair of UH–60 Black Hawks and their AH–1 Cobra escorts, the army turns to the new AH–64 Apache attack helicopter, which can match its enemies' maneuverability and firepower.

candidates.title: The Beyond
candidates.overview: Set in 2019, The Beyond chronicles the groundbreaking mission which sent astronauts - modified with advanced robotics, through a newly discovered wormhole known as the Void. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their first of its kind interstellar space journey.

candidates.title: Jug Face
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → Jug Face
candidates.overview: When a supernatural pit worshipped by a remote community in the woods demands a new blood sacrifice, a young woman struggles to find a way to survive as the pit lashes out in anger.

candidates.title: Infinite
candidates.overview: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves “Infinites” come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

candidates.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
candidates.overview: He's Ace Ventura: Pet Detective. Jim Carrey is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eyeball to eyeball with a man-eating shark, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. Whether he's undercover, under fire or underwater, he always gets his man… or beast!

candidates.title: Stripes
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → Stripes
candidates.overview: John Winger, an indolent sad sack in his 30s, impulsively joins the U.S. Army after losing his job, his girlfriend and his apartment.

candidates.title: The Abyss
candidates.overview: A civilian oil rig crew is recruited to conduct a search and rescue effort when a nuclear submarine mysteriously sinks. One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.

candidates.title: No Way Out
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → No Way Out
candidates.overview: Navy Lt. Tom Farrell meets a young woman, Susan Atwell , and they share a passionate fling. Farrell then finds out that his superior, Defense Secretary David Brice, is also romantically involved with Atwell. When the young woman turns up dead, Farrell is put in charge of the murder investigation. He begins to uncover shocking clues about the case, but when details of his encounter with Susan surface, he becomes a suspect as well.

candidates.title: Prometheus
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → Prometheus
candidates.overview: A team of explorers discover a clue to the origins of mankind on Earth, leading them on a journey to the darkest corners of the universe. There, they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

candidates.title: Fatal Instinct
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Sean Young → Fatal Instinct
candidates.overview: Ned Ravine is a police officer and lawyer who occasionally defends the delinquents he arrests. He crosses paths with seductive Lola Cain during an assignment and promptly begins an affair with her. Meanwhile, Ned's wife, Lana, is deep in an affair of her own. Lana and her lover are planning to murder Ned in an elaborate fashion so they can collect on his triple indemnity life insurance policy.

candidates.title: Dreamscape
candidates.overview: A government funded project looks into using psychics to enter people's dreams, with some mechanical help. When a subject dies in their sleep from a heart attack, Alex Gardner becomes suspicious that another of the psychics is killing people in the dreams somehow and that is causing them to die in real life. He must find a way to stop the abuse of the power to enter dreams.

candidates.title: Body of Lies
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → Body of Lies
candidates.overview: The CIA’s hunt is on for the mastermind of a wave of terrorist attacks. Roger Ferris is the agency’s man on the ground, moving from place to place, scrambling to stay ahead of ever-shifting events. An eye in the sky – a satellite link – watches Ferris.  At the other end of that real-time link is the CIA’s Ed Hoffman, strategizing events from thousands of miles away. And as Ferris nears the target, he discovers trust can be just as dangerous as it is necessary for survival.

candidates.title: The Butterfly Effect
candidates.overview: A young man struggles to access sublimated childhood memories. He finds a technique that allows him to travel back into the past, to occupy his childhood body and change history. However, he soon finds that every change he makes has unexpected consequences.

candidates.title: Blade Runner 2049
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Harrison Ford → Blade Runner 2049
candidates.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

candidates.title: Possessor
candidates.overview: Tasya Vos, an elite corporate assassin, uses brain-implant technology to take control of other people’s bodies to terminate high profile targets. As she sinks deeper into her latest assignment, Vos becomes trapped inside a mind that threatens to obliterate her.

candidates.title: Alien: Covenant
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → Alien: Covenant
candidates.overview: Bound for a remote planet on the far side of the galaxy, the crew of the colony ship 'Covenant' discovers what is thought to be an uncharted paradise, but is actually a dark, dangerous world—which has a sole inhabitant: the 'synthetic', David, survivor of the doomed Prometheus expedition.

candidates.title: Robot Overlords
candidates.overview: Earth has been conquered by robots from another galaxy and the human survivors must stay in their homes, or risk incineration.

candidates.title: The Last Duel
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → The Last Duel
candidates.overview: King Charles VI declares that Knight Jean de Carrouges settle his dispute with his squire, Jacques Le Gris, by challenging him to a duel.

candidates.title: Phenomenon
candidates.overview: An ordinary man sees a bright light descend from the sky, and discovers he now has super-intelligence and telekinesis.

candidates.title: The Lawnmower Man
candidates.path: The Martian → Theme: botanist → The Lawnmower Man
candidates.overview: A simple man is turned into a genius through the application of computer science.

candidates.title: Aliens
candidates.overview: When Ripley's lifepod is found by a salvage crew over 50 years later, she finds that terra-formers are on the very planet they found the alien species. When the company sends a family of colonists out to investigate her story—all contact is lost with the planet and colonists. They enlist Ripley and the colonial marines to return and search for answers.

candidates.title: Oppenheimer
candidates.path: Inception → Director: Christopher Nolan → Oppenheimer
candidates.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer’s role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

candidates.title: Doctor Strange
candidates.overview: Dr. Stephen Strange embarks on a wondrous journey to the heights of a Tibetan mountain, where he seeks healing at the feet of the mysterious Ancient One.

candidates.title: Science Fiction Volume One: The Osiris Child
candidates.overview: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonization, an unlikely pair race against an impending global crisis and are confronted by the monsters that live inside us all.

candidates.title: Whip It
candidates.path: The Martian → Cast: Kristen Wiig → Whip It
candidates.overview: In Bodeen, Texas, Land Of The Dragon, an indie-rock loving misfit finds a way of dealing with her small-town misery after she discovers a roller derby league in nearby Austin.

candidates.title: Chronicle
candidates.overview: Three high school students make an incredible discovery, leading to their developing uncanny powers beyond their understanding. As they learn to control their abilities and use them to their advantage, their lives start to spin out of control, and their darker sides begin to take over.

candidates.title: White Squall
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → White Squall
candidates.overview: In 1960, a hardy group of prep school students boards an old-fashioned sailing ship. With Capt. Christopher Sheldon at the helm, the oceangoing voyage is intended to teach the boys fortitude and discipline. But the youthful crew are about to get some unexpected instruction in survival when they get caught in the clutches of a white squall storm.

candidates.title: Extracted
candidates.overview: Thomas Jacobs invents a way to watch people's memories from the inside. Going against his morals, he accepts an offer to enter a heroin addict's memories to literally see if he committed a crime. However,a malfunction causes his consciousness to become trapped inside the criminal's mind. He remains a prisoner in the addict's memories for more than four years until he discovers the possibility of escape.

candidates.title: All the Money in the World
candidates.path: The Martian → Director: Ridley Scott → All the Money in the World
candidates.overview: The story of the kidnapping of 16-year-old John Paul Getty III and the desperate attempt by his devoted mother to convince his billionaire grandfather Jean Paul Getty to pay the ransom.

candidates.title: Revolt
candidates.overview: The story of humankind's last stand against a cataclysmic alien invasion. Set in the war-ravaged African countryside, a U.S. soldier and a French foreign aid worker team up to survive the alien onslaught. Their bond will be tested as they search for refuge across a crumbling world.

candidates.title: Blade Runner: Black Out 2022
candidates.path: Blade Runner → Cast: Edward James Olmos → Blade Runner: Black Out 2022
candidates.overview: This animated short revolves around the events causing an electrical systems failure on the west coast of the US. According to Blade Runner 2049’s official timeline, this failure leads to cities shutting down, financial and trade markets being thrown into chaos, and food supplies dwindling. There’s no proof as to what caused the blackouts, but Replicants — the bio-engineered robots featured in the original Blade Runner, are blamed.

candidates.title: Replicas
candidates.overview: A scientist becomes obsessed with returning his family to normalcy after a terrible accident.

candidates.title: Godzilla
candidates.path: Inception → Cast: Ken Watanabe → Godzilla
candidates.overview: Ford Brody, a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe. Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when an ancient alpha predator arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

candidates.title: The Cloverfield Paradox
candidates.overview: Orbiting above a planet on the brink of war, scientists test a device to solve an energy crisis and end up face-to-face with a dark alternate reality.

candidates.title: Godzilla: King of the Monsters
candidates.path: Inception → Cast: Ken Watanabe → Godzilla: King of the Monsters
candidates.overview: Follows the heroic efforts of the crypto-zoological agency Monarch as its members face off against a battery of god-sized monsters, including the mighty Godzilla, who collides with Mothra, Rodan, and his ultimate nemesis, the three-headed King Ghidorah. When these ancient super-species, thought to be mere myths, rise again, they all vie for supremacy, leaving humanity's very existence hanging in the balance.

candidates.title: Surrogates
candidates.overview: Set in a futuristic world where humans live in isolation and interact through surrogate robots, a cop is forced to leave his home for the first time in years in order to investigate the murders of others' surrogates.

candidates.title: The Last Samurai
candidates.path: Inception → Cast: Ken Watanabe → The Last Samurai
candidates.overview: Nathan Algren is an American hired to instruct the Japanese army in the ways of modern warfare, which finds him learning to respect the samurai and the honorable principles that rule them. Pressed to destroy the samurai's way of life in the name of modernization and open trade, Algren decides to become an ultimate warrior himself and to fight for their right to exist.

candidates.title: Transcendence
candidates.overview: Two leading computer scientists work toward their goal of Technological Singularity,  as a radical anti-technology organization fights to prevent them from creating a world where computers can transcend the abilities of the human brain.

candidates.title: Letters from Iwo Jima
candidates.path: Inception → Cast: Ken Watanabe → Letters from Iwo Jima
candidates.overview: The story of the battle of Iwo Jima between the United States and Imperial Japan during World War II, as told from the perspective of the Japanese who fought it.

candidates.title: Dune
candidates.overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence-a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential-only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

candidates.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
candidates.path: Inception → Cast: Ken Watanabe → Memoirs of a Geisha
candidates.overview: A sweeping romantic epic set in Japan in the years before World War II, a penniless Japanese child is torn from her family to work as a maid in a geisha house.
